name: positioning-and-story
tagline_zh: 当你的产品介绍像竞品复制粘贴，用户划走前3秒。把趋势写成反派，开发者当主角——让每个功能都变成打脸坏人的证据。
tagline_en: When your pitch sounds like every competitor, users scroll past. Make the trend the villain, the dev the.
desc_en: Build a positioning and narrative where the developer is the hero and a real trend is the villain. Use when the messaging describes the product instead of the problem, sounds like every competitor, or has no urgency because nothing is at stake.
why_zh: 它不教你堆卖点，而是用“反派-英雄”结构重排现有信息，让紧迫感从趋势里长出来，而非硬贴。
why_en: It doesn't add features—it reorders your existing facts into a villain-hero arc, so urgency emerges from the trend itself, not.
